qt: to the Commission Katri Kulmuni (Renew), Merja Kyllönen (The Left) Subject:

In Finland, freezing temperatures can cause failures in AdBlue-based exhaust after-treatment systems in agricultural, forestry and construction machinery. According to a survey by INFRA ry, the Finnish association which represents infrastructure contractors, nearly 85 % of respondents reported such problems in earthmoving machinery, continuously or occasionally, at temperatures below –11°C. Equipment damage leads to repair costs and downtime, potentially disrupting infrastructure maintenance, construction and mining operations, including critical raw material supply chains. Non-road mobile machinery is subject to Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 (Stage V framework)1. Solutions should maintain emissions standards while ensuring technology neutrality. 1.
How does the Commission assess whether the Stage V framework ensures the reliable operation of non-road mobile machinery under the low temperatures regularly experienced in northern Europe?

Given that an alternative AdBlue-compatible fluid has already been developed to prevent cold-weather failures, how can the Stage V framework accommodate its use, while ensuring full compliance with EU emissions requirements and the principle of technology neutrality?

What steps does the Commission intend to take, and following what timeline, to address these challenges and facilitate the deployment of compliant technical solutions – while taking into account infrastructure contractors’ costs and potential disruptions to critical infrastructure maintenance and raw material supply chains – and will these issues be dealt with as part of the recently opened Stage V legislation?

Regulation (EU) 2016/1628 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 September 2016 on requirements relating to gaseous and particulate pollutant emission limits and type-approval for internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery, amending Regulations (EU) No 1024/2012 and (EU) No 167/2013, and amending and repealing Directive 97/68/EC, OJ L 252, 16.9.2016, p. 53, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/1628/oj. 1
